# Artifact Gateway v0.9.0

## 简体中文

本版基于已合入的 Gateway/Console 主线，包含 PR #349 的 Maven 修复；PR #346 的 CLI 分发/auth/profile 批次未纳入。Gateway、Console、OpenAPI 和发行材料统一为 0.9.0。

### 主要变化

- Console v2 提供导航 rail、命令面板、账号菜单、分组仓库任务与新的明暗主题；共享查询层统一取消、缓存、按身份清理、有限重试和各区块的错误恢复。既有链接与权限边界保留。
- 制品搜索增加不区分大小写的字面 Contains 匹配，保留省略参数时的既有行为及精确 SHA-256 查询；Console 默认 Contains 并可选择 Prefix。
- Maven Hosted 支持原始 ISO-8859-1 POM 与可精确解析的 parent-version identity，保留原始字节和校验和，继续拒绝无效 XML、未解析 identity 与坐标不匹配。
- [#348 / PR #349](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/pull/349)：Maven V2 Group 使用与单仓库一致的 canonical Maven resource 授权，精确坐标前缀获准的 GET/HEAD、制品、checksum 与 metadata 不再因原始路径匹配而被误拒绝。授权仍先于成员 payload/缓存访问；制品 metadata 精确匹配 groupId/artifactId，排除子 groupId 与相邻制品版本，同时保留获准后续成员回退。真实缺件仍为 404、已有资产但对象不可用仍为 503，本修复不会补齐缺失制品。
- 已合入的 `agctl` 源码骨架仅提供 `version`、`info`、`commands` 与通用配置/JSON/错误契约，可用 `make cli-build` 本地构建；本版发行资产仍是 Gateway/healthcheck、Console 与 OpenAPI，不包含独立 agctl 归档或 agctl 容器镜像。其他 CLI 命令和分发/auth/profile 工作继续独立跟踪。

### 从 v0.8.1 升级与恢复边界

1. 先校验正式包的 `SHA256SUMS`，核对 `VERSION.txt`、`gateway version` 与发行精确 commit；Gateway/Console 使用同一版本。保留旧软件、配置、独立 key 和一致的 PostgreSQL/对象存储恢复点，参照[恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.9.0/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)。单个在线数据库 dump 不是完整配对恢复证据。
2. 本版新增 `000145_artifact_contains_search_indexes.sql`，为 npm、PyPI、Go、APT、Cargo 搜索源创建八个 GIN trigram 索引；此前 144 项迁移文件/checksum 不变，未要求制品对象重新复制或重写。`pg_trgm` 已由既有 000064 迁移建立。
3. 000145 使用普通 `CREATE INDEX`，并由迁移 runner 在事务中应用；不是在线 `CONCURRENTLY` 创建。索引构建会阻塞相关表的写入，耗时与额外磁盘需求取决于数据量，应安排维护窗口并先排空写入者。[PostgreSQL 索引创建契约](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/sql-createindex.html)说明此锁行为。不要修改已应用迁移或跳过 ledger/checksum 校验。
4. 升级后核对完整 145 项 ledger/checksum、节点版本、`/livez` 与 `/readyz`，用现有精确身份核验已知制品、Group 读取和搜索，再恢复写入。源码 CI、隔离 fixture 和发行资产验证与目标业务验收分开记录。
5. v0.8.1 的“144 项相同 schema、仅切换二进制”回退说明不能直接套用。本轮没有声称目标环境直接降级旧二进制已获验收；需要回退时，按恢复手册使用同一已验证恢复点的数据库、对象、配置/key 和匹配软件，不执行 down migration，也不混用无关旧库。

### 未完成工作的边界

- [#347](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/issues/347) 的远端 `go install` 通道仍不可解析：`go.mod` 声明路径与源码仓库路径不一致。新 tag 包含 CLI 源码不会自行修复这个问题；本版不宣传该安装通道可用。
- PR #346、CLI 后续 issue 和未完成的安装通道继续开放。Maven 拒绝审计、缺件与不可用对象沿用既有契约，本版不宣称完整重设计了审计事件。
- 本次是代码发行，不代表任何目标实例的制品迁移、业务消费验收或生产切换完成。缺制品、对象恢复和目标部署验证由对应工作独立跟踪。

## English

This release includes the merged Gateway/Console mainline and the Maven fix in PR #349. The CLI distribution/auth/profile batch in PR #346 is excluded. Gateway, Console, OpenAPI and distribution materials use 0.9.0.

### Changes

- Console v2 adds the navigation rail, command palette, account menu, grouped repository tasks and revised light/dark themes. Its shared query layer handles cancellation, caching, identity resets, bounded retries and section recovery while retaining existing links and permission boundaries.
- Artifact search adds case-insensitive literal Contains matching while preserving omitted-parameter behavior and exact SHA-256 lookup. Console defaults to Contains and also offers Prefix.
- Maven Hosted accepts original ISO-8859-1 POMs and exactly resolvable parent-version identities, preserving original bytes/checksums and rejecting malformed XML, unresolved identities and coordinate mismatches.
- [#348 / PR #349](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/pull/349): Maven V2 Groups authorize through the same canonical Maven resource as single repositories. Coordinate-prefix grants cover permitted GET/HEAD artifact, checksum and metadata reads before member payload/cache access. Artifact metadata selects exact groupId/artifactId, excluding child-group and adjacent-artifact versions and retaining authorized later-member fallback. Actual absence remains 404; unavailable bytes for an existing asset remain 503. This fix does not supply missing artifacts.
- The merged `agctl` source skeleton provides only `version`, `info`, `commands` and shared configuration/JSON/error contracts, built locally with `make cli-build`. Release assets contain Gateway/healthcheck, Console and OpenAPI, with no separate agctl archives or published agctl image. Other CLI commands and distribution/auth/profile work remain tracked separately.

### Upgrade from v0.8.1 and recovery limits

1. Verify formal asset `SHA256SUMS`, `VERSION.txt`, `gateway version` and the precise release commit. Keep Gateway/Console on the same version. Retain the previous software/configuration, independent keys and a consistent PostgreSQL/object-store recovery point using the [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.9.0/docs/recovery-runbook.md). An online database dump alone is not paired recovery evidence.
2. Migration `000145_artifact_contains_search_indexes.sql` adds eight GIN trigram indexes for npm, PyPI, Go, APT and Cargo search sources. Previous 144 migration files/checksums are unchanged; artifact object recopy or rewrite is not required. Existing migration 000064 establishes `pg_trgm`.
3. The runner applies ordinary `CREATE INDEX` in a transaction, without `CONCURRENTLY`. Building indexes blocks writes on the affected tables; duration and extra disk space depend on data size. Plan a maintenance window and drain writers first. The [PostgreSQL index contract](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/16/sql-createindex.html) documents the locking behavior. Preserve applied files and ledger/checksum verification.
4. Verify the complete 145-entry migration ledger/checksums, node identity, `/livez` and `/readyz`, then known artifact bytes, Group reads and search with existing precise identities before reopening writes. Source CI, isolated fixtures, release assets and target acceptance are separate evidence.
5. The v0.8.1 binary-only rollback statement for an identical 144-entry schema does not apply unchanged. This release does not claim target acceptance for direct old-binary downgrade. Recovery uses matching software and database/object/configuration/key material from the same verified recovery point; do not run down migrations or mix unrelated old databases.

### Remaining work

- Remote `go install` remains unresolved in [#347](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/issues/347): the declared module path differs from the source repository. A new tag containing CLI source does not fix this; the channel is not advertised as working.
- PR #346, further CLI issues and unfinished installation work stay open. Existing Maven denial/missing/unavailable-object audit contracts are retained rather than described as a complete audit redesign.
- Publication does not declare any target's artifact migration, business-consumer acceptance or production rollout complete. Missing artifacts, object recovery and deployment verification remain separate work.
